title: Hal-xidhaalaha Carshiga Fog
intro: Boqor awood leh, oo lagu barakeeyey xukun aan caadi ahayn, ayaa wajahay caqabad gaar ah oo ay la kulantay boqorad ka timid dhul fog. Boqorku wuxuu isku dayay inuu muujiyo awood iyo xigmad rabbaani ah, isagoo bilaabay dhacdo cajiib ah oo ka hor imaanaysa sharciyada waqtiga iyo booska. Ma soo saari kartaa faahfaahinta dhacdadan mucjisada ah?
clues: Taliye waxaa la siiyay awood aad u weyn, oo ay ku jiraan xakamaynta makhluuqaadka aan la arki karin iyo awoodda uu ku amri karo dabaysha.
Taliyihii wuxuu helay war ku saabsan boqorad hodan ah oo caabudi jirtay qorraxda, wuxuuna go'aansaday inuu ku casuumo maxkamadda.
Kahor imaatinka boqoradda, taliyuhu wuxuu muujiyay rabitaan ah inuu kursigeeda awoodda leh ee quruxda badan ka keeno boqortooyadeeda fog.
Jinni xoog badan ayaa soo bandhigay inuu soo ceshado shayga ka hor inta uusan taliyuhu ka soo bixin golihiisa.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qof aqoon qoto dheer u leh Qorniinka Rabbaaniga ah ayaa bixiyay dib u soo celin degdeg ah, isagoo shaqada ku dhammaystiraya ilbiriqsi.
Markii uu yimid, taliyuhu wuxuu amray in shayga la beddelo si loo tijaabiyo garaadka iyo aragtida boqoradda marka ay ugu dambeyntii gaarto qasriga.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
